# Data objects

Every endpoint returns typed value objects instead of associative arrays. The classes below are
plain PHP classes with public, promoted constructor properties: read them, pass them around, but
treat them as immutable.

This page is generated from `src/DTO` by
[`docs/tools/generate-dto-reference.php`](../tools/generate-dto-reference.php). Field descriptions come
from the `model` metadata the public API returns with every payload, so they track upstream.

## Conventions

| Convention | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Timestamps | The API sends epoch **milliseconds**; the library converts them to `DateTimeImmutable` in **seconds**. |
| Unknown fields | Ignored. A field the library does not model yet is simply not accessible. |
| Missing fields | Throw `InvalidArgumentException`, unless the property is optional and has a default. |
| Renamed fields | The `JSON field` column shows the upstream key when it differs from the PHP property. |
| `-1` sentinels | Several numeric fields use `-1` to mean "not applicable", for example `leastCashUsed`. |

## Tile

`Kan\NkOpendata\DTO\Tile` in `src/DTO/Tile.php`.
